required_treatment: Brand-family breadth only; not structural category breadth or competitive strength.
Selected complete focal-category evidence; not market share or full-market leadership.
No cross-category magnitude averaging and no 2025–2026 methodology bridge.
Incumbent and challenger opportunities are unequal.
Require a comparable source-native universe; CRP is not market share.
Preserve entity, segment, geography, consolidation, and continuing-operation scope.
Separate reported, constant-currency, organic, and derived growth definitions.
Do not infer volume from revenue without a disclosed bridge.
Use only an explicitly reported price, mix, or combined price/mix measure.
Require a compatible accounting and entity scope.
Margin is an outcome, not a strategy, and must retain the reported calculation basis.
Separate recurring, underlying, and reported measures.
Do not compare margins across incompatible entities or accounting definitions.
Capex is an investment input unless an operational result is separately observed.
Separate announced, installed, commissioned, and utilised capacity.
Do not relabel outlet, distributor, or geographic counts as consumer reach.
Use the term market share only when the source explicitly measures market share for a defined market.
